subject.title: refactor(apns): move registrations to shared SQLite

question: Must the release or startup path guarantee the APNs Doctor migration before SQLite-only runtime reads, or is a documented manual `openclaw doctor --fix` step acceptable for existing installations?
rationale: This choice determines whether an ordinary upgrade may interrupt stored APNs wake and approval delivery until an operator performs a separate command.

options.title: Gate the cutover
options.body: Add an update/startup migration gate with an actionable Doctor recovery path and prove live delivery before and after upgrade.

options.title: Accept manual Doctor
options.body: Treat explicit Doctor execution as a supported release prerequisite, document it prominently, and provide real installed-upgrade proof that operators receive an adequate warning.

options.title: Pause the migration
options.body: Keep the PR open until the project has a release-wide policy for migrations that otherwise disable persisted delivery state.

recommendation.title: Gate the cutover
recommendation.body: Add an update/startup migration gate with an actionable Doctor recovery path and prove live delivery before and after upgrade.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history connects this person most directly to the APNs relay contract and this migration design.
